items.title: How much does a case-study-and-referral habit actually add to the pipeline?
items.description: This extends L1's three-month Omar-vs-Sana gap out to a full year. Each case study a rep writes generates some number of qualified referrals, and referred leads close at a meaningfully higher rate than cold ones (Sana's own referral already closed within the quarter). At the defaults — 1 case study a quarter, 1.5 referrals each, a 45% close rate on those referrals, over 4 quarters, at a $20,000 average deal size in Sana's and Dana's range — the habit alone accounts for $54,000 in cumulative revenue that a rep who skips both steps, like Omar, never generates. Drag any slider to zero to see the habit's contribution disappear entirely.

params.name: caseStudiesPerQuarter
params.label: Case studies (+ referral ask) written per quarter

params.name: referralsPerCaseStudy
params.label: Qualified referrals generated per case study

items.compute: const dealSize = 20000; let totalRevenue = 0; for (let q = 0; q < params.quarters; q++) { const referrals = params.caseStudiesPerQuarter * params.referralsPerCaseStudy; const wins = referrals * (params.referredCloseRate / 100); totalRevenue += wins * dealSize; } return { cumulativeReferredRevenue: Math.round(totalRevenue) };
